findings.finding: HITL-028 explicitly uses hitl.approved for immediate scheduler queue reevaluation on approval/rejection resolution. CV-082 and the Runtime event catalog carry-through table name approval.granted as the durable HITL/approval-resolver event; HITL Tier-era compatibility retirement defines the durable approval outcome/principal/scope. CV-215 assigns the persisted wake_reason to scheduler.pass as approval_resolved. The spelling is a live wake notification label; it is not proved to be a separate saved-history family or a renamed wire event. Keep notifications and existing durable resolution.
findings.negative_evidence: Exact-token live-canon search finds no separate payload schema, persisted value, or producer requirement for this notification spelling. Storage command-compatibility prose lists hitl.approved migration-only; it does not retire the HITL-028 wake notification and does not independently decide hitl.rejected.
